content: समाधानम् .²1 Putting together, uniting. .²2 Fixing the mind in abstract contemplation on the true nature of spirit; बिभ्रत्यात्मसमाधानतपःस्वाध्यायसंयमैः <ls>Bhāg. 12. 11. 24</ls>. .²3 Profound or abstract meditation, deep contemplation. .²4 Intentness. .²5 Steadiness, composure, peace (as of mind), satisfaction; चित्तस्य समाधानम्; समाधानं बुद्धेः <ls>G. L. 18</ls>. .²6 Clearing up a doubt, replying to the Pūrvapakṣa; answering an objection. .²7 Agreeing, promising. .²8 (In drama) A leading incident which unexpectedly gives rise to the whole plot. .²9 Justification of a statement, proof. .²10 Reconciliation. .²11 Eagerness.
